today_summary: GCM26 prints $4,177.2 on the 10-14 snapshot, -$13.3 (-0.32%) and now below the $4,187 shelf that acted as the decider for four straight sessions. ATM IV compressed to 19.32%, a 5-day low and -1.08pp in a single session, cutting the 1-sigma daily move to $50.84 (1.22%) — the tightest of the cycle. Volume exploded to 17,773 contracts, a 5-day high and +241% from Monday's 5,207, but 89.6% of it was calls and only 9.0% traded within ±$200 of spot; 42.3% of all call volume printed at strikes ≥$6,000. Local net GEX inside ±$200 sits at -199.5 (call +215.7 against put -415.3) with the gamma flip at $4,795, leaving spot $618 deep inside short-gamma territory.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions have netted +$36.6 (+0.88%), $4,140.6 to $4,177.2, inside a $75.6 (1.83%) box that still contains every print — but the composition of that chop has changed completely. Volatility is the real move: ATM IV has bled 20.76% to 19.32% (-1.44pp) in a near-monotonic slide, pulling 1-sigma from $54.15 to $50.84 and marking the tightest vol regime of the cycle. The gamma pocket round-tripped and ended where it started — local net GEX ran -257.5 to -113.5 on Monday and back to -199.5, with the flip strike walking only $4,845 to $4,795 (-$50) — so dealers are as short gamma at the money as they were a week ago, even though total chain GEX rose +$100.2 to 337.2 (+42.3%) on far-OTM call builds ($7,000 +1,514, $7,500 +1,488, $6,500 +1,396). Participation has inverted outright: calls were 53.8% of volume on 10-08 with 21.7% of flow inside ±$200 of spot, versus 89.6% calls today with only 9.0% near the money and 42.3% of call volume at $6,000-plus strikes. The one genuinely directional build is defensive and distant — put OI added +826 at $3,700 and +601 at $3,975 across the five days, hedges 5-11% below spot — while P/C OI has not budged off 0.39 and max pain has drifted a trivial +$5 to $5,500.

prediction: Bias neutral with a downward tilt while $4,187 caps, and the 1-sigma envelope $4,126.4-$4,228.0 now sits entirely inside the five-day box — compressed IV plus a 5-day-low 9.0% ATM participation argues for more range before resolution. Upside needs $4,228 reclaimed to re-target $4,300 (2,029 call OI) and then $4,400 (2,418 OI), where net GEX first turns durably positive at +15.5; the $5,500 max pain exerts no pull from 31.7% overhead at 42 DTE. Loss of $4,140, the five-day low and below the 1-sigma floor, opens $4,100 (2,200 put OI) and $4,050 (2,472 OI) toward the $4,000 wall (4,319 OI), and with local net GEX -199.5 that break accelerates rather than reverts.
